explanation: The 'ST1100 ABS' model is a known variant of the Honda ST1100 Pan European, with 'ABS' referring to the anti-lock braking system added in later production. The 'Pan European' designation is the official market name for this model in Europe and other regions, and 'ST1100 ABS' is a common way to refer to the same motorcycle with added safety features. The core model identity remains unchanged.
